name: legate
description: Delegated authority over tmux sessions. Dispatch AI agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini) to work in parallel, debrief them for status, or inspect their workspace yourself.

interface.shortDescription: Dispatch and manage tmux agent sessions
interface.longDescription: Launch Claude Code, Codex, or Gemini CLI sessions in tmux windows, send follow-up instructions, debrief their progress, and inspect sessions directly.
defaultPrompt: Dispatch a separate agent session for this task.
